faq_heading: Ironwood real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Ironwood is an MLS® sub-area of Richmond. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 63 homes sold there: 22 houses, 26 condos and 14 townhomes. 26 condos sold in Ironwood with a median price of $535,000 (the middle half sold between $482,500 and $608,500), taking a median of 34 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 0% sold above list.
Ironwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

26 condos sold in Ironwood with a median price of $535,000 (the middle half sold between $482,500 and $608,500), taking a median of 34 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $728 per square foot, a median year built of 2014 and a median strata fee of $582 a month. 22 houses sold in Ironwood with a median price of $1,387,500 (the middle half sold between $1,264,900 and $1,837,500), taking a median of 31 days to sell at 93.9% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $660 per square foot, a median year built of 1978 and a median lot of 6,584 square feet.

items.t: The City has an Ironwood Sub-Area Plan (Schedule 2.8A) listed under the City's Shellmont Area.
That plan fronts Steveston Highway and No. 5 Road, with Highway 99 on the east edge and Agricultural Land Reserve land north of its Area C.
Area A (south side of Steveston Highway) is commercial; Area B (north side) is townhouse and multi-family; Area C ("The Gardens") is mixed-use with mid-rise buildings of 4 to 6 storeys.
A single-family neighbourhood lies north of Area B.
The plan was adopted in 2001, last amended in 2022, and does not set specific zones; it defers to the Zoning Bylaw.

The City's 2024 small-scale multi-unit housing zoning (RSM) applies to single-family lots outside the five transit-oriented areas, which surround the Bridgeport, Capstan, Aberdeen, Lansdowne and Brighouse stations.

blocks.text: Ironwood: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: The plan requires at least 0.2 ha of public open space in Area C, a perimeter greenway along Steveston Highway and No. 5 Road, and a proposed City "agricultural-park" north of The Gardens.
Ironwood Library is at 8200-11688 Steveston Highway.
Ironwood Plaza is a 169,000 sq ft centre anchored, per its developer, by London Drugs and Overwaitea Food Group.
The Ironwood plan does not mention schools.
SD38 sets catchments by Board designation and provides a locator.

blocks.text: Ironwood: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: A 3 m landscaped buffer runs along the north edge of Area C to protect the adjacent ALR.
A 15 m riparian management area runs along Highway 99.
Parking in Area C must sit below the lowest permitted habitable storey set by the Flood Plain Designation and Protection Bylaw.
Richmond relies on 49 km of dikes.

faq.q: What did condos in Ironwood sell for?
faq.a: 26 condos sold in Ironwood between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $535,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Ironwood?
faq.a: The median was 34 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.6% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Ironwood sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 26 condos that sold in Ironwood went for between $482,500 and $608,500, around a median of $535,000.

faq.q: Do condos in Ironwood sell above asking price?
faq.a: 0% of the 26 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.6% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Ironwood?
faq.a: Of the 26 sales, 26 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $582.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Ironwood?
faq.a: The median year built was 2014 for the 26 condos sold in Ironwood.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Ironwood usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Ironwood had 2 bedrooms, from the 26 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Richmond?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
